Actor.description:
Identifies the specific participant who authored a `User` or `Assistant`
conversation item, for conversations with more than one distinct actor
on that role (e.g. MSC's end-user/agent distinction, or a Teams channel
thread). Absent when the item's role alone identifies the author.

Serializes as a tagged object (`{"type": "msc_user"}`, `{"type": "teams", ...}`,
etc). Deserialization additionally accepts the bare strings `"End_User"` /
`"Customer_Service_Agent"` for `MscUser` / `MscAgent { name: None }` — MSC's
legacy `/instruction` and `/suggestion` endpoints have sent exactly those two
string values on the wire for years, so reading that shape can't be dropped.
Nothing produces it anymore; it's accepted, not emitted.

AgenticUnparkPayload.description: Unpark payload for agentic activity - user continues conversation via orchestrator

query.description: User's query to continue the conversation

reasoning_summary.description:
A reasoning model's concise summary of its own chain-of-thought (e.g.
OpenAI Responses API `reasoning.summary`), surfaced for observability.
Deliberately separate from `reasoning`, which elsewhere in the
orchestrator/analytics stack means why the system took an action
(fallback trigger, classification, guardrail) — conflating the two
would surface a model's internal thinking where a business-logic
rationale is expected.

oneOf.description:
OpenAI Responses API `phase: "commentary"` text: an intermediate
preamble emitted before a tool call, distinct from the turn's final
answer. Plain assistant-authored text, not hidden reasoning like
`Thinking`.

A sensitive string (masked in debug output).

- `is_external: true` — the value came from an external source (e.g. user/API input)
  No decryption is needed.
- `is_external: false` — the value is internally managed (e.g. a database default)
  and is stored encrypted. It must be decrypted before use.

Secret.description:
A sensitive string (masked in debug output).

- `is_external: true` — the value came from an external source (e.g. user/API input)
  No decryption is needed.
- `is_external: false` — the value is internally managed (e.g. a database default)
  and is stored encrypted. It must be decrypted before use.

ContextValue.description:
Value of context
- Plain: A non-sensitive string (media and structured data stored as JSON strings)
- Secret: A sensitive string (not printed in debug)

Contexts.description: Type alias for a mapping from strings to context values

FlowToolDefinition.description: Flow-based tool definition with a mandatory tool ID.

FunctionDefinition.description:
Common function shape: name, description, and parameters.
Re-used by `ToolOption::Function` and `ToolOption::Routing`.

allOf.description:
any remaining JSON Schema keywords we don't model explicitly. catch-all
for things like `pattern`, `format`, `minLength`, etc. — keywords that
strict-mode openai rejects and that we deliberately don't surface as
typed fields, but pass through for non-strict consumers.

$defs.description:
`$defs`: named subschemas usable from `$ref`. accepts the legacy
`definitions` key as an alias on input.

oneOf.description: `additionalItems`: schema for items beyond the tuple defined by `items`.

anyOf.description: `anyOf`: a tagged union of acceptable schemas.

oneOf.description: `const`: a single allowed value. spec is type-agnostic.

enum.description: `enum`: any allowed values. spec is type-agnostic, hence `JsonValue`.

oneOf.description: For arrays: a schema for the items

required.description: For objects: names of required properties

JsonTypeSpec.description: JSON Schema `type` field: either a single type (`"string"`) or a union (`["array", "null"]`).

McpToolDefinition.description: MCP-based tool definition with a mandatory server ID.

oneOf.description: A new media content part which is not yet uploaded into HALO

Transient.description: A new media content part which is not yet uploaded into HALO

oneOf.description: A media content part with data, and can be dematerialized

Materialized.description: A media content part with data, and can be dematerialized

oneOf.description: A media content part without data, but it can be downloaded

Dematerialized.description: A media content part without data, but it can be downloaded

ModelResult.description: Model result discriminated union - matches Python ModelResult type

RagChunk.description: RAG chunk for knowledge retrieval results

ServerToolDefinition.description: Server-side tool definition (e.g. Anthropic web search).

TimerUnparkPayload.description: Unpark payload for timer (empty - no data needed when timer fires)

ToolState.description: Unified tool state that covers both Flow and MCP tool states

ToolUseTrace.description: Trace information for a tool use execution step

ToolUseTraceState.description: State of a tool use trace step

TranslationContent.description: Translation input content (either text or message list)

oneOf.description:
Mixed content (e.g. user replied with both text and an image).
Carries the full ordered list of content parts so the agentic LLM
can reason over both the text query and the media together.

UserResponse.description: User response in an unpark payload`.
